messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update — today we published a change to our leave policies. We merged 'sick' + 'personal' into a single PTO bank, and we've expanded bereavement and caregiver leave. See short bullet summary below and link to the full policy. :memo:

Liam (Eng): Thanks — does this affect carryover or payout at year‑end?

Maya (People Ops): Good Q — carryover limit stays the same (48 hrs), payout rules unchanged. The PTO bank just simplifies requests and visibility. Changes effective May 1, 2025. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/leave-bank-updates

Jordan (HR Partner): Bereavement expanded to cover extended family and domestic partners; caregivers now get 5 days/year (non‑cumulative) for urgent care needs. Managers can approve the caregiver days; serious cases route to People Ops for ad‑hoc support. :heart:

Anya (People Ops): To request these leaves use the Absence Portal -> 'New Request' -> select 'PTO bank' or 'Caregiver leave'. If you need retroactive coverage for qualifying events since Jan 1, submit a ticket to people-ops and include dates.

Liam (Eng): Cool. Any change to parental leave or FMLA coordination?

Maya (People Ops): No change to parental leave or FMLA. If you plan to combine leaves for a continuous absence we'll help coordinate eligibility and benefits.

people-ops-bot: Policy doc updated by Maya (People Ops) — timestamp 1752001234 — /policies/leave-bank-updates

Anya (People Ops): We ran a short FAQ session at 3pm today; recording and slides are on the policy page. Please flag any edge cases in the thread or DM People Ops. Thanks! :raised_hands:
